gaps.lead: He was driving too fast, so he crashed.
gaps.sentence: He wouldn't have crashed if he ___ so fast.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect continuous: hadn't been driving.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen such a good film for ages.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ I had seen for ages.
gaps.explanation: Not…such a good film for ages = the best film (I had seen) for ages.

gaps.lead: They say this forest is three hundred years old.
gaps.sentence: This forest ___ three hundred years old.
gaps.explanation: They say → is said to be / is thought to be; with keyword THOUGHT: is thought to be.

gaps.lead: The rescue team managed to reach the village by helicopter.
gaps.sentence: The rescue team ___ reaching the village by helicopter.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = succeed IN doing.

gaps.lead: He spoke so quickly that nobody understood him.
gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ for anybody to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so quickly that nobody understood = too quickly (for anybody) to understand.

gaps.lead: I last saw him in March.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect with since + point in time: haven't seen him since (March).
